outcome: Two products cannot be created with the same code.

acceptance_criteria.text: Codes are compared without regard to case or surrounding whitespace.

expected_verification.assertion: two codes differing only in case are treated as duplicates

acceptance_criteria.text: The uniqueness constraint can be added to a catalogue that already holds rows, without blocking writes while it is built.

expected_verification.assertion: the migration applies to a populated skus table without taking a write-blocking lock

data_impact: Adds an index. Rejects future duplicate codes; existing duplicates block the migration.
rollout: Migration applied ahead of the application release.
rollback: Dropping the index restores the previous behaviour.
